content:
zara (partnerships): Ping — SkylineCloud wants our joint listing live Mon 08:00 PT and their copy calls out a 10-rack Dedicated bundle. their PO shows 10 but vendor manifest only lists 6. need options fast. :thinking:
dave (procurement): PO SK-2210 states 10 committed. vendor sent a revised manifest this morning with only 6 assigned. who has the manifest?
leo (logistics): manifest excerpt: ```PO: SK-2210
assigned_racks: 6
shipment_id: SHP-7711
status: pending customs paperwork```
anya (eng-ops): runtime note: we can spin a preview by combining the 6 racks with 3 hosted warm nodes but perf differs. would require a listing-specific routing override and cost tags.
announce-bot: [inventory-scan] committed:10 assigned_manifest:6 hosted-warm:5 eu-spare:1
maria (sales): Skyline marketing insists on the phrase "Dedicated Rack Bundle" in hero copy. they want a firm capacity statement.
tom (legal): advise avoiding fixed counts in public copy. propose: "Now available in preview on Skyline Marketplace; dedicated deployment provisioning subject to shipping manifests."
dave (procurement): mitigation choices: (A) ask vendor to reassign 4 racks from their other manifest (expedite cost +$30k) (B) hybrid: 3 hosted + 3 spares + 3 assigned to reach 10 (needs routing override) (C) delay listing until manifests reconcile.
leo (logistics): Customs paperwork could take 24-72h. Reroute/exchange might take 48h even expedited.
anya (eng-ops): routing override snippet we can use: ```routing_override: allow_listed_fallback=true
notes: tag requests, surface latency delta (~+12% p95)``` infra sign-off required, enable ~45m after approval.
zara (partnerships): Skyline needs an answer in 90 minutes. low-friction route to keep timeline?
dave (procurement): safest to keep timeline is option B (hybrid) with conservative copy. I'll contact vendor for reallocation but don't rely on it.
maria (sales): i'll tell Skyline marketing the listing will be a "preview with limited live demo capacity" and confirm we will update copy once manifests finalize.
tom (legal): approved wording. also add "subject to final shipping manifests and provisioning".
zara (partnerships): actions: Dave -> vendor reallocation request, Anya -> infra override ticket, Leo -> customs docs chase, Maria -> vendor & Skyline comms. I'll post final blurb after vendor confirm. :thumbsup:
announce-bot: [action-created] A-7780 enable-listing-fallback-for-skyline by eng-infra due: 1748517076
zara (partnerships): thanks everyone — update in 60m.
